guard_ranges.reason: Architectural vector trampolines; reset and interrupt delivery remain interpreted.
Known whole-function NMI AOT stack leak and nested COP/RTI ownership; retain the AOT barrier. Separately qualified fixed instructions require explicit existing-owner scope limits.
Boot/vblank routines $82803B/$828043, including $82804D/$828051, retain interpreter ownership. Separate preceding math leaf ends in RTL at $82803A; its hardware accesses still fall back.
Babel patches actor/OAM culling operands in memory for widescreen; compiled immediates would become stale.

fixed_instruction_scopes.schema: gaia fixed instruction owner scopes v1
fixed_instruction_scopes.contract: The unchanged ranges and four historical NMI floors block whole-function AOT, not already-qualified single-instruction effects. Fixed instructions retain the original retirement, frames, bus effects and existing owners; new protected-range instructions require exact owner-scope restrictions. Only the two stock long-JMP vector instructions may be selected; reset and IRQ vectors remain excluded. RDNMI acknowledgements/poll controls stay outside this registry; the existing separate poll island is unchanged. Runtime all/single/file/programmatic exclusions are never bypassed.

qualification: Generation creates private replay candidates. Only matched execution at identical guest points can qualify a native path; fixed-instruction scope metadata is not execution or campaign proof.
